summary: 43 features and 4 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • achievements: project TurboEngine track as incomplete when DLC is disabled (0fcd4ff)
  • skills: add fallback skill inventory enumeration (ff57baf)
  • grains: integrate preset task catalog into ui-master scene settings (23aecfd)
  • preset-tasks: add requirements to last30days and ui-master plugins (b4f00ca)
  • preset-tasks: register requirement check service and add startup logging (7e6143d)
  • preset-tasks: add requirement check API and catalog integration (43843d5)
  • preset-tasks: add requirement check service and models (9caa5bc)
  • preset-tasks: add last30days research plugin and command documentation (303ac68)
  • dlc: add program-level DLC options and effective catalog service (9b3e0bd)
  • preset-tasks: add reference vaults and target projects to ui-master (43cb8ad)
  • achievement: add Microsoft Store sponsor event handling (9d52a26)
  • achievement: add desktop Microsoft Store sponsor achievement bootstrap (286af0e)
  • resources: add ui-master task preset plugin (a9288ec)
  • application: implement plugin-backed task preset catalog system (d1ee256)
  • resources: expand Impeccable preset task with full command catalog (2642bdf)
  • preset-tasks: add command catalog support and improve RSS feed (325fd90)
  • resources: add preset task configuration and UI Polish task (07d5426)
  • resources: add preset task prompts in English and Chinese (bfca249)
  • api: add preset tasks controller and models (0eda7d5)
  • preset-tasks: add preset task catalog provider and startup activator (32d1ff6)
  • professions: add GLM 5.2 model support (cf0dfe4)

HagiCode-org/web

  • preset-tasks: add requirement check UI and validation (4e2b5d4)
  • preset-tasks: add requirement check types and API (f11c95f)
  • api: add requirement check DTOs (f1f3d5a)
  • achievement: add turbo engine DLC achievement translations (6ebcada)
  • achievement: add turbo engine DLC achievement (e2858c5)
  • api: update generated API models and services (e977ee4)
  • preset-task: add documentation link to command catalog (17afcd7)
  • preset-task: add scope tabs component and enhance preset task drawer (217a129)
  • session: support research vaults and projects in preset tasks (db50f4a)
  • achievement: format reward amounts with special handling for sponsor milestone (69f3012)
  • achievement: add Microsoft Store sponsor achievement type (845d5f1)
  • preset-task: integrate research vault and project reference selectors (f3bfda5)
  • i18n: add preset task command catalog localization (78c893c)
  • session: add preset task catalog loading and menu integration (d225ffe)
  • preset-task: implement enhanced preset task drawer with command catalog (5026c91)
  • preset-task: enhance session creation with input structure (aa63155)
  • api: add comprehensive preset task API models (a791d13)
  • preset-task: add command catalog UI component (2c417e2)
  • preset-task: add command catalog hydration and hidden parameter support (454342d)
  • preset-task: add preset task API and type definitions (0c4db72)
  • types: add workflow plugin manifest type definitions (e2178a3)
  • hero: add GLM 5.2 model support (0894ad0)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • controllers: improve tips API locale handling (b9a3996)
  • auto-task: extend reference vaults and target projects to preset tasks (9a9e4c1)

HagiCode-org/web

  • ui: improve responsive layout for input components (9ce4523)
  • hero: remove unused fallback text from hero summary (bbc23ec)
